claim: A turnstile standing in an open concourse with free passage beside it reads as a toy: the player sees he can walk round it. A gate earns its place only where it is the way through.
evidence: the owner, 2026-11-25, of Gravesend Station's turnstile: 'little weird if you can just go around it'; it was removed (projects/blood-city/references/station-design.md)
use: Put a turnstile in the only opening of a fenced line, or leave it out.
